summary: On the owner's Ubuntu NAS VM (3.4 GiB RAM, about 2.0 GiB MemAvailable at idle with the desktop session running) candidate A could not be measured without swapping. The only run (A, original runner, 1 thread) swapped out 921 MiB and in 572 MiB and is discarded. Candidates B, C and D could not be built because files.pythonhosted.org is blackholed by the local DNS (resolves to 0.0.0.0) on the Mac and on the VM, so the Python export toolchain (torch, onnx, laya==0.4.12) cannot be installed; the DNS block was not circumvented.

environment.vm: Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS, Linux 7.0.0-38-generic x86_64, KVM guest 'Standard PC (i440FX + PIIX, 1996)', 16 logical CPUs (guest view), Haswell-class flags: avx, avx2, fma, f16c, sse4_2; no avx512, no VNNI, no AMX
environment.memory: MemTotal 3468792 kB (3387 MiB), swap 3.9 GiB (swappiness 60, systemd-oomd active), desktop session running (gnome-shell, ptyxis)
environment.node: v24.21.0 linux-x64 official tarball (SHA-256 fd8e59d5a511510f6a298afb548f18c7d2b1be404d8b4a27d94fbe49f56cb2d6 verified against SHASUMS256.txt), onnxruntime-node 1.30.0, @huggingface/transformers 4.3.1, npm install --ignore-scripts into a scratch directory, no lockfile
environment.runner: scripts/spikes/decision-laya.mjs from branch head bf052d60; the six model files were verified on the Mac against the manifest SHA-256 and copied to the VM with scp (the runner verifies them again before each run)
environment.cleanup: ~/plur1bus-laya-bench on the VM (models, node, runtime, outputs) deleted after the attempt

A.reason: vmstat shows swap activity in 156 of 272 sampled seconds (swap-in 585660 KiB, swap-out 943083 KiB in total); model load took 79.0 s; MemAvailable dropped to 782 MiB; swap in use grew from 298 MiB to 645 MiB, pushing the desktop session's memory out. The run is not a valid latency measurement.

discardedRun.label: A-orig-t1
discardedRun.note: Not a valid timing (swap thrash). Kept only as evidence that A (about 1.7 GiB RSS) does not fit next to the desktop session on this VM. Picks are deterministic and equal the cloud and Windows receipts.

A.otherRuns: not run: threads 2 and 4 and the candidate runner were cancelled after the first run swapped, so as not to push the owner's desktop session further into swap

B.reason: The export needs torch, onnx, onnxscript, transformers and laya==0.4.12 from PyPI. files.pythonhosted.org resolves to 0.0.0.0 in the local DNS on both the Mac and the VM (pypi.org itself answers). Not circumvented.

D.reason: needs onnx and onnxruntime from PyPI (fp32 upcast plus dynamic int8 quantization), same DNS block

ramRule: Run only with load1 < 0.5, no heavy foreign process and MemAvailable >= 1900 MiB; discard any run with vmstat si/so > 0.
next: Needs more VM RAM (A: about 1.7 GiB RSS plus the desktop session; B about 1.0 GiB and C/D about 0.6 GiB would fit) and the PyPI file host unblocked in DNS so that B, C and D can be built, copied and measured. They would then run unchanged with scripts/spikes/decision-laya-candidates.mjs.
